method: self-review re-derivation of reviewer leads, with original source statements inspected; not a blinded independent review

claims.original_claim: If k(n)/n tends to p in (0,1), log2 binom(n,k)=n H2(p)+O(log n).
claims.verdict: refuted, with the smallest valid counterexample
claims.counterexample: p=1/4 and k=floor(n/4+sqrt(n)). Taylor expansion H2(1/4+u)=H2(1/4)+log2(3)u+O(u^2) gives a difference log2(3)sqrt(n)+O(log n), which is not O(log n).
dependencies: Taylor expansion of binary entropy on a compact interval inside (0,1)
claims.scope: The exponential conclusion survives. Quantitative remainder is repaired.

claims.original_claim: A set retraction pi:G->H that does not increase generator cost proves intrinsic and ambient lengths agree on H.
claims.verdict: correct only after a stated restriction
claims.counterexample: G=(Z,+), H=2Z, restricted generators ±2, ambient generators ±1, ±2, ±3, all unit cost. Define pi(even)=itself and pi(odd)=0. Every ambient generator maps to a restricted generator or identity. Yet 6 has restricted length 3 and ambient length 2.
claims.safe_statement: Require a group homomorphism retraction, or a map on paths whose projected endpoint and total cost have the required properties.
dependencies: Multiplicativity of pi over a word
claims.scope: General retraction template; not a retraction claimed to exist for the six-row atom.

claims.original_claim: Left-multiplied prefixes s_t...s_1 are edges in the right-coset Schreier system H\G.
claims.verdict: correct only after a stated restriction
claims.counterexample: Left multiplication of Hg is not well-defined for a nonnormal subgroup H: a different representative hg gives shg, which need not belong to Hsg.
claims.safe_statement: Use left cosets G/H with the left action gH -> sgH. To identify base-fiber paths with intrinsic words require the base-preserving ambient labels to have the stated restricted realization cost, e.g. S_H=S_G intersect H.

claims.original_claim: Nonnegative integer generator costs give a formal Green series whose coefficients count all finite words of each cost.
claims.verdict: correct only after a stated restriction
claims.counterexample: A zero-cost involution permits infinitely many zero-cost repetitions. The constant coefficient word count diverges and I-A(0) is singular for a permutation action.
claims.safe_statement: Require positive integer scalar costs, or use an explicit free-move contraction/other completed semiring with separately proved finiteness.
dependencies: Finite number of words for a fixed total degree
claims.scope: Weighted counting series; zero-one BFS metric computations remain valid under their own algorithm.

claims.original_claim: Separate nonincreasing projections imply direct-sum word length is the sum of factor lengths.
claims.verdict: correct only after a stated restriction
claims.counterexample: C2 x C2 with all three nonidentity elements available at unit cost projects nonincreasingly to each C2 factor. The target (1,1) has length 1 but both factor lengths are 1.
claims.safe_statement: Require an aggregate cost budget across projected words, plus cost-preserving independent lifts for the upper bound.
dependencies: Cost cannot be charged twice to the same large-system gate
claims.scope: Abstract amplification criterion; concrete linear-core lower bounds require their own proof.

claims.original_claim: No-ancilla NOT/CNOT/Toffoli generate every permutation of n-bit strings for all n.
claims.verdict: refuted, with the smallest valid counterexample
claims.counterexample: At n=4 each gate acts as respectively 8,4,2 disjoint transpositions, hence is even. A single transposition is unreachable.
claims.safe_statement: State the generated subgroup, or restrict the full symmetric-group assertion to a validated small width.
claims.scope: Does not change complete three-bit enumeration.

claims.original_claim: Changing nonnegative scalar resource weights can change the sign of restricted-minus-ambient optimum for nested admissible circuits with identical word costs.
claims.verdict: refuted, with the smallest valid counterexample
claims.counterexample: Set inclusion alone gives min_ambient cost <= min_restricted cost for every fixed weight, so the difference is never negative.
claims.safe_statement: Weights may change whether the defect is zero or positive and which realization is optimal.

claims.hypotheses: Finite-dimensional Hilbert space; same initial unit state and unitary sequence for exact and approximate trajectories; orthogonal projectors chosen adaptively from prior approximate states; no renormalization; measurement effect 0<=M<=I.
dependency_graph: e_0=0 and unitary norm preservation imply ||e_m||<=sum ||d_t||
quadratic form difference is bounded by (||psi_m||+||phi_m||)||M||||e_m||<=2sum||d_t||
